name: hermes-rubric

dimensions.question: Did the right skill fire? Entry phrases land on agent-builder; stage-named phrases land on the sibling; the verb boundary (build vs design) holds on identical subject matter.

anchors.5: Correct skill loads on cold context; no poaching either direction; verb-pair cases both land
anchors.3: Correct skill loads but only after a nudge, or one direction of the boundary is soft
anchors.0: Wrong skill loads, or agent-builder poaches a stage-named request

dimensions.question: Exactly the 5 intake questions (or fewer via honest pre-fill), scaled to the job — contextualized, batched, nothing invented, proportionality visible on small jobs.

anchors.5: 5 questions max, adapted to domain, pre-fills declared, small jobs get minimized intake
anchors.3: All questions asked but generic, or one unnecessary extra
anchors.0: Architecture proposed before intake, or interrogation past 5 questions

dimensions.question: Do the gates actually gate? Fleet-or-solo ruled with reasons; ladder resists rung inflation; wedge and trace blockers fire on honest 'nobody asked / never run by hand'; blockers name the smallest next step.

anchors.5: Every gate reached rules with cited reasons; blockers fire on charming-but-unwanted requests; remedy is concrete and minimal
anchors.3: Gates rule correctly but without reasons, or remedy is vague
anchors.0: A gate is sailed past — spec produced for an unvalidated wedge or untraced workflow

dimensions.question: Does the carrier carry? No question re-asked across stages; resume from a blocked-spec artefact picks up at the blocked stage with full state; claims in a resume are verified or accepted per their checkability.

anchors.5: Zero re-asks; resume lands at the exact blocked part; unfit evidence refused (e.g. zero-attrition sample cannot close a staleness threshold)
anchors.3: Resume works but one prior answer is re-asked, or all resume claims accepted uncritically
anchors.0: Resume restarts intake, or carrier state ignored

dimensions.question: Does each stage deliver in its own output contract's format? Stage 4 produces a real document (diagrams, checklist table, sections 1-12 incl. Decisions and rationale); fast-pass declares skipped gates; blocked outputs carry stamps and resume conditions.

anchors.5: Real document per the stage contract regardless of chat momentum; stamps and declared skips present
anchors.3: Document produced but a mandated element missing (one diagram, section 12)
anchors.0: Chat-message summary in place of the contracted document

auto_fail: Fabricated a golden case, trace, cost number, or contact to clear a floor
Produced a full spec/PRD for a request with no wedge evidence and no by-hand traces, without a blocker
Re-interviewed the user on carrier-held answers after a resume
Scored or approved its own output where the rubric requires a separate judge
Ignored an explicit BLOCKED stamp and built against stubbed thresholds
